title: Business or job? What your birth chart says | Ask Tota
description: Vedic astrology reads business through the 7th, 3rd and 10th houses and employment through the 6th and 10th. The indicators astrologers use, and their limits.
og_title: Business or job: what your chart says
og_description: The 7th house of trade, the 6th of service, the 3rd of initiative, and the 10th over all of them. How astrologers read the question, honestly.

llms_title: Business or job in Vedic astrology
llms_desc: how Vedic astrology reads the choice between business and employment: the 10th house (career), 7th (business, partners, trade), 6th (service, employment), 3rd (initiative, self-effort) and 11th (gains), planets associated with each (Mercury, Mars, Saturn, Sun, Rahu), common indicators, timing through dashas, and limits.

faq.q: how do i know if business or job suits me in astrology?
faq.a: astrologers compare the 7th house of business and trade, and the 3rd of initiative, with the 6th house of service and employment, all in relation to the 10th house of career. strong links between the 10th and 7th lean toward business; between the 10th and 6th toward employment.

faq.q: which house is for business in astrology?
faq.a: the 7th house, of partnerships, trade and dealing with the public. the 10th is career in general, the 3rd self-effort and initiative, and the 11th gains from all of it.

faq.q: which house is for job in astrology?
faq.a: the 6th house, of service, daily work, employment and competition. a strong 6th to 10th connection is a classic indicator of a career in service or employment.

faq.q: which planet is good for business?
faq.a: mercury is the natural significator of trade and commerce. mars adds initiative and risk tolerance. rahu is linked with unconventional or large-scale ventures. a strong lagna lord gives the self-reliance business needs.

faq.q: which planet is good for government job?
faq.a: the sun is the natural significator of government and authority. a strong sun connected to the 10th house, often with saturn's influence for structured service, is a common indicator of government work.

faq.q: is there a business yoga in astrology?
faq.a: there is no single classical 'business yoga'. astrologers combine several indicators: the 7th and 10th lords linked, a strong 3rd house, a dignified mercury, and the lagna lord in the 7th or 10th.

faq.q: can someone do both business and job?
faq.a: of course, and many charts show both. a strong 6th and a strong 7th can describe someone who works a job and runs a side business, or moves from one to the other with the dashas.

faq.q: when is a good time to start a business according to astrology?
faq.a: astrologers look at dashas of the 7th, 10th, 11th or lagna lords, transits of jupiter over the 10th or 11th, and choose a muhurat for the launch. but market conditions and preparation matter far more.

faq.q: does saturn favour job over business?
faq.a: saturn signifies service, labour and long structured careers, so a strong saturn influence on the 10th is often read as suiting employment or slow-building enterprises. it can also describe very durable businesses.

faq.q: is partnership business good in my chart?
faq.a: the 7th house is partnerships, so its lord's strength and the planets in it are read for how partnerships tend to go. it is a reflective prompt; real partnership decisions need trust, contracts and due diligence.

faq.q: can astrology tell me if my business will succeed?
faq.a: no. no controlled study shows charts predict business outcomes. use astrology to reflect on ur temperament and timing, and use market research, finances and advice for decisions.

faq.q: what does the 10th house show about career?
faq.a: the 10th is the house of career, status and public role. its sign, lord and occupants describe the kind of work and recognition a person tends toward.
